title: Rajaji National Park Uttarakhand | Complete Travel Guide, Safari & Timings
content:
Rajaji National Park - Uttarakhand,

Rajaji National Park is one of the largest and most beautiful wildlife sanctuaries in Uttarakhand, covering over 820 sq km across Haridwar, Dehradun, and Pauri Garhwal districts. Established in 1983 and named after the first Prime Minister of India, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru (Rajaji), the park is famous for its rich biodiversity, including tigers, elephants, leopards, sambar deer, and a variety of bird species.

The park is a combination of dense forests, grasslands, rivers, and hills, making it a perfect habitat for wildlife and a paradise for nature lovers and photographers. Rajaji is also part of the Shivalik Elephant Reserve, offering opportunities to spot Asian elephants in their natural habitat.

Visitors can enjoy jeep safaris, elephant safaris, trekking, and bird-watching tours. The park has multiple entry points, including Chilla, Motichur, and Rajaji sections, each offering unique wildlife experiences. The tranquil setting of the park, coupled with the thrill of spotting wild animals, makes it a must-visit for both adventure enthusiasts and families seeking a nature getaway.

Best Time to Visit:

  • October to June: Ideal for safaris and wildlife spotting.
  • Monsoon (July-September): Avoid due to heavy rainfall and slippery trails.
  • Morning and Evening: Best time for wildlife activity.

Things to Do at Rajaji National Park:

  • Jeep safari through dense forests and grasslands.
  • Try elephant safaris in select zones.
  • Bird-watching tours for rare species like hornbills and eagles.
  • Explore scenic hill trails and riverbanks.
  • Enjoy nature photography of landscapes and wildlife.

How to Reach Rajaji National Park:

  • By Road: Haridwar and Rishikesh are nearest towns, well-connected by bus and taxi.
  • By Train: Haridwar Junction is the closest railway station.
  • By Air: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun (35 km from Chilla zone).

Travel Tips: Book safaris in advance to secure a spot, Carry binoculars, cameras, and comfortable shoes, Follow park rules strictly - do not disturb wildlife, Avoid plastic; maintain cleanliness inside the park, Hire certified guides for better wildlife spotting.
excerpt: Rajaji National Park Uttarakhand is a top wildlife destination known for tigers, elephants, leopards, and rich biodiversity. With jeep and elephant safaris, bird-watching, and scenic forest trails, it offers adventure, nature, and photography opportunities. Ideal for families, travelers, and wildlife enthusiasts visiting Haridwar and Rishikesh.
